liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lost Sailor** (2 reviews): Reviewer recalls purple and blue stage lights during the rain-falling section of Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance; Reviewer rates the Lost Sailor into Saint of Circumstance sequence as the show's standout [14][18]
- **Touch of Grey** (2 reviews): Reviewer highlights it as the first time Touch of Grey was played live; Reviewer notes this was the first live performance ever of Touch of Grey, and calls that very significant [16][17]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Opening with Playin' in the Band followed by Crazy Fingers struck the reviewer as unusual [21]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer remembers Little Red Rooster as one of the hottest versions they ever heard [21]
- **Saint of Circumstance** (1 review): Reviewer praises Bobby's playing and Jerry's frenzied playing about four minutes into Saint of Circumstance [18]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): The jam coming out of Space into Not Fade Away is described as really grooving [19]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer considers this Stella Blue possibly the best they have heard, with every note felt [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **PITB Jam #1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **PITB Jam #2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- **PITB Jam #2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Touch of Grey [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-09-15.134869.nak300.schley.flac2448** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 143 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1982-09-15.152348.beyer.m160.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 148 min [4]
- **gd1982-09-15.sbd-aud.cribbs.8550.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 137 min; rated 4.21/5 by 14 [8]
- **gd82-09-15.sbd-patched.clugston.11881.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 139 min; rated 3.48/5 by 21 [9]. Said about its sound: Soundboard copy contains a few patches taken from an audience source, according to the reviewer; Playin' and part of Crazy Fingers come from audience tape, because the band started early with house lights still on; Playin' into Crazy Fingers is an audience patch, but reviewer says it shouldn't deter listeners [13][14][15][20][22]
- **gd1982-09-15.fob.tigerrose.howard.andrewf.81690.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 138 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [10]. Said about its sound: First notes of Playin' are slightly clipped on this audience source; A tape flip in Drums cuts into the start of the jam; Touch of Grey sounds different [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended; recalls a heavy fog outside after the show [13]
- Reviewer was at school on Maryland's eastern shore and had just returned from the UVA show [17]
- Reviewer's first Grateful Dead ticket purchase, which cost $12.50 [19]
- Reviewer recalls Jerry playing nearly nonstop through the first set, with no lengthy tuning or smoke breaks [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-09-15.134869.nak300.schley.flac2448**: taped by Brian Schley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP-4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII. Set up inside SBD perimeter area for 1st Set, mics moved onto SBD platform for 2nd Set,… [1]. Also: Nakamichi 300 source by Schley, patched from two other sources in Playin' Jam 2, Lost Sailor and Drums [1]
- **gd1982-09-15.152348.beyer.m160.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (3)Beyer M160 mics > Nakamichi 550 [4]. Also: Rob Eaton recorded this with Beyer M160 mics and did the transfer; Charlie Miller coordinated the project; Brian Schley's Nakamichi 300 source supplies a 26-second patch within Drums [4]
- **gd1982-09-15.sbd-aud.cribbs.8550.sbefail.shnf**: taped by see notes; transferred by see notes; source: see notes [8]. Also: Soundboard reel (MSC) transferred by Jim Wise, normalized by Sean Cribbs, with patches from Tiger Rose's audience tape; Tiger Rose taped from front of board with Nak shotgun mics into Sony TC-D5M; David Howard transferred it [8]
- **gd82-09-15.sbd-patched.clugston.11881.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]
- **gd1982-09-15.fob.tigerrose.howard.andrewf.81690.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Tiger Rose; transferred by David Howard and Andrew F; source: "Recorded by Tiger Rose, FOB Nak shotgun mics > Sony TC-D5. MAC > CD Analog to Digital transfer by David Howard." [10]. Also: Complete audience master (MAC) from Tiger Rose, obtained from Jim Wise in 2001, supplied patches for other sources [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1982-09-15 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1982-09-15-backstage-pass/) [24]
